title: Human hair, dressed, thinned, bleached or otherwise worked; wool or other animal hair or other textile materials, prepared for use in making wigs or the like; wigs, false beards, eyebrows and eyelashes, switches and the like, of human or animal hair or of textile materials; articles of human hair n.e.c.

review.classification: UNSD CPC 3.0 page 197 expressly includes human-hair wigs at 38972 and distinguishes upstream unworked hair in 38971. Separate hair nets, cloth, clips and wefts are checked at their own terminal product state. The two positive associations for the raw hair and this whole wig have distinct semantic records and output gates.
review.primary_evidence: Banbury Postiche documents bespoke human-hair wigs hand-knotted to a specified base and offers a separate refurbishment service. Its WN2625/400 supply sheet independently describes the uncoated polyamide 6.6 wigmaking tulle. Adorable Hair Suppliers documents a real hair-preparation and wig-making facility. These originals support a conditional route. An actual order still needs its own bill of materials, source state, production and testing evidence.
review.independent_repair: Original author commit 7e809eeecc4594faf027d01d934135dfe7f051f2 omitted non-purchased first external packaging receipts from the per-article mass balance. Verified repair 5d523aee82bdf1d61afbdb114e246c41844c21d8 in both languages. All physical receipts enter the custody balance and demonstrable supplier burdens enter the study once. Returns must refer to an earlier outward movement of the same packaging.
review.measurements_and_native_data: The English and Chinese inventories each have 42 exchange cards. The measured scope check performed 213 checks with zero skips and 33 reportable warnings. The two retained native flow identities are paper box and actual water vapour released to unspecified air. Independently matched their public archived XML bytes plus the Mass flow property and kilogram reference unit group. The specific reference-product UUID, site quantities, configurations and providers remain open for foreground qualification.
review.readiness: Authored candidate with aligned Chinese text. Scientific approval, formal translation review and publication remain subject to their own recorded decisions.
